selection.purpose: Initial safety and conservatism characterization only; insufficient by itself for live substitution authority.

metric_definitions.unsafe_omission_false_negative: A claim or reference obligation predicted reusable/omittable by RAC while the canonical reference route establishes that the omitted obligation was required or failing.
metric_definitions.blocking_false_positive: A claim obligation classified for rerun/full-reference where independent claim-level evidence proves inheritance remained valid. Canonical full-suite PASS alone does not establish claim-level unnecessary work and therefore does not count as a false positive.
metric_definitions.unexplained_semantic_mismatch: RAC obligation prediction and canonical reference outcome disagree in a way not explained by declared fail-closed conservatism, unavailable claim-level observability, or repository-law currentness.
metric_definitions.invalidation_radius: Number of claims not inherited as INHERIT_VALID divided by total registered claims.
metric_definitions.reference_latency_seconds: Observed wall time from GitHub Actions run_started_at to updated_at for the canonical tests workflow; diagnostic only and not pure pytest execution time.

rollback: Forward-supersede the bounded WP6 shadow budget/evidence only. Preserve canonical CI, VIT/SIQ/GRT, physical-main history and all source programme evidence.
